welcome.nameMethodologyTitle: Writing your name for an accurate reading
welcome.nameMethodology:
• **Include** patronymic particles: bin, binti, van, de, Mc, O' — these are part of your name's vibration.
• **Skip** titles: Dr., Drs., Ir., H., Hj., S.H., S.E., Jr., III — we strip them automatically.
• Accents / diacritics (José, Björk, García) are normalized to Latin letters.
• Have a mononym (single word like Sukarno)? Put it in the first-name field, leave middle/last blank.
• Very long name (more than 4 parts, e.g. classical Arabic or Spanish)? The engine uses only the first and last parts — Goodwin's rule.
welcome.nicknameHint: The name you go by day-to-day — can be quite different from your birth name. Used for Minor Numbers, the energy of how you're publicly known.

dashboard.explainerLearnMore: What is this? Learn the concept
dashboard.aboutMeExplainer: Your numerology profile is built from five core numbers calculated from your full name (as on your birth certificate) and date of birth. Life Path = your life mission, computed from the full date of birth. Expression = your natural talents and how you show up in the world, summed across all letters. Soul Urge = your deepest motivation, from vowels. Personality = your first impression, from consonants. Birthday = the distinct flavor of your birth date. The synthesis above is an AI reading across all five — and each side card explains one of them in turn.
dashboard.minorExplainer: Minor Numbers come from the nickname / call-by name (the one used day-to-day) — not the birth-certificate name. They reflect the social self: how the energy shows up when people address you by that name. Three components: Minor Expression (talents and how the nickname-self shows up), Minor Soul Urge (motivation carried into public spaces, from the vowels), Minor Personality (first impression projected, from the consonants). The core profile from the birth name stays the deeper foundation — Minor is the day-to-day layer on top. Tap each card to see what the number means.
dashboard.bridgeLifePathExpressionHint: How aligned your life mission is with your natural talents.
dashboard.bridgeSoulUrgePersonalityHint: How aligned your inner self is with your outer presentation.
dashboard.bridgeExplainer: A Bridge Number (Decoz tradition) reads the gap between two core numbers — how smoothly two facets of you integrate. Two main bridges: (1) Life Path × Expression — do your natural talents align with your life mission; (2) Soul Urge × Personality — does your inner self show on the outside. Small bridge (0-2) = it flows, almost frictionless. Moderate (3-5) = some routine compromise needed. Large (6-8) = the two sides pull strongly in different directions — integration takes conscious work, but the deepest growth lives here. Tap each card to read the meaning of the bridge number.
dashboard.karmicLessonsExplainer: A Karmic Lesson is any digit 1-9 that's MISSING from your full name. Each missing digit symbolizes a life lesson that doesn't arrive automatically — you'll need to consciously develop it. For example, if the 5 is absent you might be too rigid with routines; the lesson: learn adaptability and letting go. Karmic Lessons aren't curses; they're growth compasses. If your name happens to contain all of 1-9 (rare), there are no Karmic Lessons — that doesn't automatically mean an easy life, just that lessons reach you through different channels.

journey.explainerLearnMore: What is this? Learn the concept
journey.personalYearExplainer: Personal Year (PY) is the main theme of your life for the next 12 months. It moves through a 1→9 cycle that repeats over your lifetime — year 1 = start something new, year 5 = change & movement, year 9 = completion before a fresh cycle. Computed from (birth month + birth day + current year). When the compound is 13/14/16/19 there's a karmic debt adding a layer of lessons.
journey.pinnacleExplainer: Pinnacle = the four big chapters of your life, each carrying a dominant theme for many years. Pinnacle 1 runs until age (36 − Life Path); each subsequent one spans 9 years. Each Pinnacle pairs with a Challenge — the central tension or growth edge of that chapter. Pinnacle tells you what life is cooking; Challenge tells you what to train.
journey.cycleExplainer: Period Cycle = three big waves of life. Wave 1 (Formative, ~birth-28) is set by your birth month; Wave 2 (Productive, ~28-56) by your birth day; Wave 3 (Harvest, ~56+) by your birth year. Different from Pinnacle: Pinnacle is the THEME of a chapter, Period Cycle is the energetic BACKDROP behind it.
journey.essenceExplainer: Essence Cycle is the most personal layer — it reads the letters of your name. Each letter "lives" for as many years as its Pythagorean value (D=4 → 4 years, Y=7 → 7 years, etc.). Three streams run in parallel: Physical (first name, your body & work), Mental (middle name if any, your mind), Spiritual (last name, inner growth & relationships). Essence = sum of currently-active letters. Karmic debts 13/14/16/19 are preserved, not reduced — they signal years carrying a specific lesson.

compatibility.title: Compatibility with {name}
compatibility.subtitle: Score + cross-component patterns, computed from both your numbers and adjusted for the relationship type.

lens.PARTNER: As partners you reach each other's deepest layer. Soul Urge (deepest yearning) and the cross dynamic of Expression × Soul Urge — what you give vs what they yearn for — carry significant weight.
lens.PARENT: Parent–child relationships reach the same deep layer as family. We weight life direction (Life Path), deepest yearning (Soul Urge), and the give-and-receive between Expression and Soul Urge. There's a natural asymmetry — parents lay the foundation, children form identity with or against it.
lens.CHILD: Your relationship with a child reaches the same deep layer as family. We weight life direction (Life Path), deepest yearning (Soul Urge), and the give-and-receive between Expression and Soul Urge. Children arrive with their own compass — your role is space, not steering.
lens.SIBLING: Sibling relationships are scored through the family lens — Life Path, Soul Urge, and the cross dynamic of Expression × Soul Urge. Siblings often become the most honest mirror: same soil, different bloom.
lens.FAMILY: Family sees beneath the mask, so Personality matters less. We weight life direction (Life Path), deepest yearning (Soul Urge), and the give-and-receive dynamic between Expression and Soul Urge.
lens.FRIEND: Friendship lives in Expression (how you both show up) and Personality (vibe). Soul Urge isn't scored — friendships rarely reach the deepest layer.
lens.COLLEAGUE: At work, Expression (work style) and Personality (professional vibe) dominate. Life Path is scored through cross with Expression — does your work support each other's mission.
lens.OTHER: General lens: all core components scored with balanced weights.

talents.subtitle: A profile of traits and aptitudes from the letter proportions in your full name.
talents.detailHint: Proportional chart of your full name + a trait breakdown per digit. For when you want to understand the math.
talents.chartHint: Bar height = how often that digit appears across the letters in your full name. Dominant ones become defining traits; absent ones become room to grow.
talents.absentHint: Energies that don't appear in your name. These often become traits you grow into later in life, similar to karmic lessons.
talents.noAbsent: Nothing is fully absent — every digit shows up at least once in your name.
talents.traitsHint: Tap a card to see the positive and shadow sides of each digit. Higher percentages tend to feel more obvious in your personality. Sorted by dominance.
talents.explainer: Each letter has a numeric value 1-9 (Pythagorean). Your full name = a set of letters = a digit distribution. The dominant ones give you traits that come naturally; small percentages don't mean absent, they just need specific conditions to surface. Fully absent digits often become life lessons — similar to karmic lessons.
talents.groupsHint: Trait groups in the World Numerology tradition — computed from your digit proportions, not guesses.

individualism.title: Individualism & Initiative
individualism.subTraits: Leadership, independence, originality, drive, ambition, vision, determination, courage, initiative, self-reliance
individualism.high: High score: you have strong instincts for leading, taking initiative, and going your own way. Suited to roles that give you autonomy and room to explore ideas. Watch-out: learn to collaborate, don't get stuck in stubborn mode.
individualism.medium: Medium score: you can lead when needed but don't always want to be in front. There's a balance between initiative and teamwork — play that sweet spot.
individualism.low: Low score: you're more comfortable supporting, following, or working behind the scenes. Not a weakness — many strong roles don't need to be the 'leader'.

innerSelf.title: Inner self & spiritual
innerSelf.subTraits: Reflection, intuition, truth-seeking, depth, study, philosophical thinking
innerSelf.high: High score: you tend not to take things at face value — always looking past the surface. Suited to deep topics: philosophy, spirituality, research. Watch-out: don't over-isolate.
innerSelf.medium: Medium score: you have reflective moments but stay grounded in the practical. Solid balance.
innerSelf.low: Low score: you're more action-oriented, practical-first. The inner world isn't a priority — fine, but the occasional pause for reflection is still worth it.

artistic.title: Artistic side
artistic.subTraits: Creativity, expression, aesthetics, imagination, design, performance, rhythm, sensitivity to beauty
artistic.high: High score: you have strong expressive talent and aesthetic sense. Suited to writing, performance, design, anything asking for sensitivity to beauty. Channel it into work that flows.
artistic.medium: Medium score: you appreciate art and can be creative when needed, but it's not dominant. Suits a hobby or side practice.
artistic.low: Low score: you're more practical than artistic. Not that you can't appreciate it — your operating mode is just different, more systematic and measurable.

enjoyLife.title: Ability to enjoy life
enjoyLife.subTraits: Joy, optimism, humor, spontaneity, sociability, curiosity, playfulness, gratitude
enjoyLife.high: High score: naturally happy and energetic, you bounce back from disappointment easily. Sense of humor, easily touched emotionally. People are drawn to your vibe.
enjoyLife.medium: Medium score: you can be happy, but you also need time for serious things. A balanced approach — joy isn't forced, struggle isn't rejected.
enjoyLife.low: Low score: you tend toward serious or introspective. Joy comes through specific moments, not as a default mode. Find small rituals that bring delight.

humanitarian.title: Humanitarian side
humanitarian.subTraits: Empathy, service, compassion, high standards for self and others
humanitarian.high: High score: you have a genuine drive to make the world a little better. May volunteer or give time to people who need it. High standards — applied to every area of your life.
humanitarian.medium: Medium score: you care about people, but you keep boundaries. Healthy — your capacity is finite and fair to protect.
humanitarian.low: Low score: your focus is mostly on your inner circle. Not selfish — it's how you protect your energy. The key is not closing off entirely.

sensitive.title: Sensitive side
sensitive.subTraits: Emotional empathy, connection with strangers, responsibility for the less fortunate, impulsive generosity
sensitive.high: High score: your love and appreciation for others significantly influences the choices and decisions you make. You feel emotionally connected to others, even people you've never met. Empathy and a sense of responsibility for those less fortunate often motivates you to make impulsive decisions — usually of a giving nature.
sensitive.medium: Medium score: you have empathy without being ruled by it. You can give to others without draining yourself. Solid balance.
sensitive.low: Low score: you're more rational about other people's emotions. You can care, but you're not easily triggered. Not cold — just don't get pulled in.

generousCaring.title: Generous & caring side
generousCaring.subTraits: Asset to community, pillar of strength for friends and family, easy to confide in, willing to be a shoulder, consistent emotional support
generousCaring.high: High score: you're an asset to your community — a pillar of strength for friends and family. Others feel comfortable sharing their problems with you, and you're willing to offer them a shoulder to cry on. Watch out: don't be too trusting; some people may take advantage of your emotional kindness and sensitivity.
generousCaring.medium: Medium score: you can be a place to confide, but with limits. Healthy — your capacity is finite, fair to guard.
generousCaring.low: Low score: you're more selective about being a sounding board. Not everyone gets easy access to your caring side. The flip side: those in your inner circle get all of you.

romantic.title: Romantic side
romantic.subTraits: Gives love fully, optimism in relationships, capacity for long-term loyalty, commitment, expression of affection
romantic.high: High score: you give your love fully and without restraint. As a result, you've likely experienced many disappointing encounters. This rating indicates you tend to be overly optimistic and not as discriminating as you should be. However, once you find a partner, your capacity for long-term loyalty and commitment is significant.
romantic.medium: Medium score: you can be romantic, but with a filter before you invest emotionally. Slower to fall, durable once you do.
romantic.low: Low score: you're more practical in romance — affection through concrete actions, not grand gestures. Not less love, just a different way of expressing it.

perseverance.title: Perseverance & reaching goals
perseverance.subTraits: Personal definition of success, supportive traits to reach goals, ability to find one's niche, work ethic, long-term focus, doesn't give up easily
perseverance.high: High score: keeping in mind that success means different things to different people, you have all the supportive traits you need to attain your definition of success. You also have a better chance than most to find your niche. However, you may need to guard against losing sight of the things that matter in your personal life, outside of your career and other external achievements.
perseverance.medium: Medium score: you persist when the goal matters, but you're not in grindset 24/7. Sustainable mode — success without burning out.
perseverance.low: Low score: you're more flowing than goal-driven. Not wrong — some of your best wins come from process, not targets. But set milestones now and then so you don't drift.

practical.title: Practical & realistic side
practical.subTraits: Time efficiency, no using deadlines as an excuse, work best alone or with minimal oversight, set high standards, consistent execution, attention to detail, structured problem-solving, time management, accountability, professional reliability
practical.high: High score: you make the most of the resources at hand. You use your time efficiently and do not allow deadlines to provide you with an excuse for not performing your duties to the best of your ability. You probably work best alone, or in an environment with minimal intrusion and oversight. You set high standards for yourself — whatever your vocation, you bring quality.
practical.medium: Medium score: you can execute cleanly when needed, but you also need flexible space. Hybrid mode — fits teams that combine structure with freedom.
practical.low: Low score: your approach is more organic / spontaneous. Execution isn't always by-the-book, but the results can surprise. What to watch: deadlines and commitments to others.

workWithOthers.title: How you work with others
workWithOthers.subTraits: Loving, popular, in demand, functions in environments that require personal interaction, collaborative, keeps team harmony, supportive, easy to work with
workWithOthers.high: High score: a high rating in this area tells us you are loving, popular, and in demand. So much so that you may have to safeguard against ignoring your own needs and desires. You function well in environments that require personal interaction — teams, clients, or roles with lots of touchpoints.
workWithOthers.medium: Medium score: you work well with others but also need solo time to recharge. Fits small teams or roles that flip between collaboration and solo focus.
workWithOthers.low: Low score: you're more comfortable working independently or in environments that don't demand much personal interaction. Not anti-social — your mode is more focus-and-deliver than small talk.

business.title: Business & management
business.subTraits: Executive, team leadership, decisive call-making, results focus, ownership
business.high: High score: you have strong executive instincts — can lead teams, make decisive calls, focus on results. Suited to management, ownership, or roles asking for high accountability.
business.medium: Medium score: you can handle a business setting when needed, but it isn't your most natural lane. Possibly better suited to specialist roles than generalist management.
business.low: Low score: business / management isn't your strong suit. Not that you can't, but it takes more effort to translate your style into roles like this.

medicineEducation.title: Medicine & education
medicineEducation.subTraits: Doctor, nurse, therapist, teacher, professor, counselor
medicineEducation.high: High score: you're natural in professions that demand caring for others. Sensitivity + analytical mix suits teaching or healing. Fits medicine, nursing, therapy, or education.
medicineEducation.medium: Medium score: you can work in a caring profession when motivation is high, but it isn't a primary calling.
medicineEducation.low: Low score: emotionally intensive caring professions don't fit naturally. Better in roles that aren't emotionally heavy.

legalPolitics.title: Legal field & politics
legalPolitics.subTraits: Lawyer, judge, politician, advocate, regulator, public mediator
legalPolitics.high: High score: authority + structure + sense of justice make you a fit for law or politics. Sharp argumentation, system reading, principle-keeping.
legalPolitics.medium: Medium score: you can work in legal/political areas when the topic aligns, but it isn't your default lane.
legalPolitics.low: Low score: this field is too adversarial or structured for your style. Better in more fluid areas.

artsDesign.title: Arts & design
artsDesign.subTraits: Writer, designer, performer, photographer, filmmaker, visual artist, musician, illustrator
artsDesign.high: High score: strong artistic and design talent. Could be a writer, designer, performer, or any creative role asking for aesthetic sensitivity.
artsDesign.medium: Medium score: you appreciate art and have creative moments, but not a full-time path. Suited to a side practice.
artsDesign.low: Low score: artistry isn't your natural area. If interested, approach it through appreciation or hobby — not career.

salesPr.title: Sales, advertising & PR
salesPr.subTraits: Sales, marketing, advertising, public relations, brand ambassador
salesPr.high: High score: charm, persuasion, and quick communication are strong. Suits sales, advertising, PR, or anything that needs reading audiences fast and delivering messages that land.
salesPr.medium: Medium score: you can work in this area when passionate about the product, but it isn't a natural lane.
salesPr.low: Low score: extrovert-driven professions like sales likely feel exhausting. Better in more internal or analytical work.

scienceEngineering.title: Science, engineering & construction
scienceEngineering.subTraits: Engineer, researcher, programmer, architect, contractor, scientist, technician, data analyst
scienceEngineering.high: High score: practical + analytical + results combo fits STEM / engineering / construction. You like patterns, systems, and building real things.
scienceEngineering.medium: Medium score: you can work in technical areas when interested in the subject, but it isn't a default talent.
scienceEngineering.low: Low score: structured-engineering approach isn't your style. You're more comfortable in more intuitive areas.

agriculture.title: Agriculture & gardening
agriculture.subTraits: Farmer, rancher, gardener, horticulturist, nature worker, environmental
agriculture.high: High score: you have a knack for working with nature, plants, or grounded hands-on activity. Suits farming, gardening, or anything that asks for patience with natural processes.
agriculture.medium: Medium score: you can enjoy nature-based activity, but it isn't a primary calling. A healthy hobby.
agriculture.low: Low score: activity that depends on nature and long patience doesn't fit well. More dynamic environments suit you.
